t1_volume.title: T1 Volume for tp1

mask1.description: Brain mask for tp1, mapped to tp2 via the xform

mask2.description: Brain mask for tp2, mapped to tp1 via the inverse xform
mask2.title: Mask for tp2

xform.description: LTA transform that aligns tp1 to tp2
xform.title: Xform

lta_src.description: Source volume for -xform if not available from the xform file
lta_src.title: LTA Source

lta_dst.description: Target volume for -xform if not available from the xform file
lta_dst.title: LTA Destination
